name: SVNIT Cube Open 2026

venue.name: Computer Science and Engineering Department, SVNIT
venue.address: SVNIT, Ichchhanath Surat- Dumas, Road, Keval Chowk, Surat, Gujarat 395007

information:
Information
• If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.

• If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification

• Participants must bring their own cubes.

• All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.

• In the event of a theft, injury, etc. the organization team will not be held completely or partially responsible.
